A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same research work and complete Appendices A–C. Full text comparison and rendered-page checks support reliable comparison of the text, equations, tables, and figures.

before.justification: v1 reports original forecasting, inference efficiency, tokenization, and conditional decoding experiments in Section 5 and Appendix C, including numerical results in Tables 2–13.

after.justification: v2 retains the original empirical results in Section 5 and Appendix C, including forecasting errors, efficiency measurements, and analyses of token representations.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Algorithms 1–2 retain identical quantization, motif vocabulary construction, conditional decoding, model architecture, and training procedures.

E1.justification: Both versions use Chronos training data and the same five evaluation datasets: ETTh1, ETTm1, Weather, Electricity, and Traffic. No task, domain, or test scenario changes.

E2.justification: Tables 2, 3, and 9 retain the same comparisons: Chronos, MOMENT, Morai, Autoformer, FEDformer, Informer, Non-stationary, and Transformer. Comparator membership within each experiment is unchanged.

E3.justification: Section 4 and Appendix B retain the same data splits, preprocessing, model sizes, training controls, metrics, and forecasting settings, including the 64-sample forecast horizon and 128-token context for the proposed and Chronos models.

E4.justification: The preprocessing, conditional decoding, quantization, motif occurrence, training dataset size, compression, and embedding analyses in Section 5 and Appendix C are unchanged.

E5.justification: Appendix B states 'We evaluate once' in both versions. The reporting practices remain identical, with no added run counts, seeds, uncertainty intervals, or significance tests.

E6.justification: All numerical results and plotted findings match, including the appendices. For example, Table 2 retains ETTh1 MSEs of 0.717 for Chronos, 0.517 for motif tokenization, and 0.459 with conditional decoding.

T1.justification: Equations (1)–(6), the quantization error bound, and the analytical conditional decoding solution are identical. No mathematical definitions, assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about pattern-centric tokenization, conditional decoding, forecasting quality, efficiency, and meaningful token representations.

C2.justification: Scientific interpretations and Section 6's limitations remain identical, including the lack of hyperparameter search because of computational cost. The new disclaimer concerns whether the publication represents Volkswagen's views.

D1.justification: Appendices A and B retain the same pseudocode, hyperparameter guidance, hardware descriptions, computational effort estimates, and dataset access information. No technical or reproducibility information changes.

R1.justification: Section 2 and all 46 numbered reference entries are unchanged. Some references move between pages, but no cited work or research positioning is added, removed, or revised.

P1.justification: v2 adds a short Disclaimer before References stating that the results, opinions, and conclusions are not necessarily those of Volkswagen Aktiengesellschaft. The arXiv version/date stamp also changes; the remaining prose and section order are unchanged.

P2.justification: The disclaimer moves References downward on page 10 and redistributes reference entries across pages 10–12. Figures 1–17 and Tables 1–13 retain identical displays and placement.

improvement.justification: v2 adds an institutional disclaimer and updates the version stamp, with limited reference reflow. The disclaimer clarifies institutional attribution, while the scientific argument, empirical evidence, reproducibility details, and appendices remain unchanged. These administrative edits produce no meaningful overall quality difference.
